mechanism: Amoxicillin may reduce fluphenazine efficacy by altering gut flora and enterohepatic circulation, while fluphenazine may increase amoxicillin CNS penetration; additive anticholinergic effects possible.
action: Monitor psychiatric symptom control and watch for increased amoxicillin neurotoxicity; consider alternative antibiotic if CNS side effects emerge or antipsychotic efficacy declines.
